utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I’m mostly skimming today, so keep me posted if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Appreciate it, Ira — just ping me if you spot anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Vik — I’ll check the donation table at the community center and bring anything missing back to Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling folks about the repair drive and see who else can help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still a little fuzzy on the latest—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I’m still keeping it simple: bring the drill and a few screwdrivers, and if you can, help me sort the donations when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring a drill and some screwdrivers, and help sort the donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like a good turnout. I might stop by and see if they need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Rey—extra hands are always welcome. If you come by, I can put you to work sorting donations or loading bins.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I can help with sorting donations or loading bins.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal — I can coordinate the volunteer sign-up and keep track of who’s available this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — could you post the sign-up sheet at the community center and let me know if we’re short on anyone? I’ll keep things organized from my place on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll post the sign-up sheet at the community center and let you know if we’re short on anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I just need the time and exact drop-off spot first, then I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send out the time and drop-off spot as soon as Eli confirms them. Thanks for helping line it up!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — once Eli confirms, just send me the time and spot and I’ll plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot first?

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still need you to confirm the timing and exact drop-off spot first, so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll check what’s still needed and then we can pick a time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — just let me know what’s still needed, and I’ll bring whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know, then we can set a time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s going on soon—I'm still catching up on the details. What should I know?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies list, so if you hear of anything we’re missing, just let me know. I’ll keep it updated and pass along any gaps right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear. I’m still a little behind, but I’ll try to help spot any missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I think it’s the drop-off-for-repairs thing. I can check the details and tell you in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help coordinate the volunteer sign-up and weekend availability.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I’ll check the details and send them over right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — the tools at 2 PM are perfect. If it’s easy, could you also bring some tape and a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll bring the tape and a flashlight with the tools at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thank you, Mina — that covers everything. See you at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—if you can, please bring a wrench and any spare screws you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a wrench and any spare screws I have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you — that’ll help a lot. See you Saturday at the repair drive.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
